messages:
zoe: hey all, first week question — trying to map who owns what across runtime, infra + oncall. who should I ping for: model serving incidents, VPC/private deploy access, and embedding infra? 

sre-oncall: welcome! :wave: quick list: alex owns serving/runtime 
mina owns infra (VPC, k8s) 
jordan owns security/private deploy gating 
for embeddings infra (indexing/ann) ping #eng-ml and alex.

alex: +1. for serving perf/regressions start by posting to #eng-runtime and mention @sre-oncall if it looks like a P1. include a short repro, trace IDs, and sample prompts.

mina: for VPC & access requests, raise a ticket in the infra queue (https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk) — tag `team=infra` and `type=network`. if you need immediate access for onboarding, DM me and I'll expedite.

zoe: thanks — what's the oncall escalation flow? who gets paged first and who to cc for P0?

sre-oncall: PagerDuty rotation pages the oncall engineer first. escalation path: oncall -> oncall lead -> eng-sre manager. if it's a security-sensitive incident, also page @jordan and add `#eng-security`.

jordan: yes, and for anything involving customer data or private deploys, treat as high-sev until triaged. we expect oncall to notify security within 15m for those.

emily: onboarding note — here's the Owners Matrix doc you want: https://docs.redwood.com/onboarding/owners-matrix (it lists team scopes, slack channels, and PagerDuty roles). also make sure you're in the `redwood-oncall` Okta group so PagerDuty can page you. people-ops granted basic infra perms but not escalation rights by default.

zoe: cool — how do I check if I'm in the Okta group or PagerDuty?

alex: you can run `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_TOKEN" https://okta.redwood.com/api/v1/groups` to see groups, but easiest is the Okta web console > Directory > Groups. for PagerDuty, open the Team page and search your email. ping me if stuck.

ops-bot: Scheduled: onboarding-access-grant job completed for zoe. Added to `eng-channel` and `infrastructure-read` groups.

mina: I've queued the private-deploy access ticket for you, zoe — putting you on the expedite list. expect an email with VPX creds in ~2h.

zoe: awesome, thanks everyone. i'll DM alex/mina to get PagerDuty and then post a test incident to the staging org so I know the flow. :thumbsup:

alex: do a small smoke alert only in staging — please don't page prod on your first test.

zoe: will do. thanks again!
